text: Published first-author IEEE conference paper — AISTS 2025, on contextual similarity matching for lightweight chatbots.
Sleep-staging ensemble that outperforms the source dataset paper's best published baseline on every overall metric and every individual sleep stage.
D-MT4SR beats its published MT4SR baseline on NDCG@10 in 10/10 seeds on Amazon Appliances and 6/6 on Industrial & Scientific — manuscript in preparation for IEEE Access.
Selected for an AI/ML model engineering internship at Onward Assist, building predictive clinical decision support.
Hand-engineered transient classifier reaching near-parity with the Zwicky Transient Facility's own production CNN, without deep learning.
Dataset audit of a published sleep-staging corpus that surfaced duplicated and mislabelled recordings affecting how its splits must be constructed.
